_comment: JEXI MCP server registry v3 (Sept 2026 — Lewis: connect them directly, no switches). Every server here was REALLY connected and tool-called by the live test (scripts/mcp-live-test.js, multiple rounds). No paid keys anywhere. uvx servers need Python+uv on the host; npx needs node; streamable-http needs only network. A memory-guarded few wake at boot; the rest connect lazily on first use — mcp/tool-directory.json lets the planner see every tool without holding 35 child processes.

servers.name: filesystem

servers.notes: Roots = the JEXI workspace only.

servers.name: memory

servers.notes: Cross-check on JEXI's own memory layers.

servers.name: mslearn
servers.description: Microsoft Learn MCP (hosted, official) — search and read Microsoft's entire documentation.

servers.name: cloudflare-docs

servers.name: playwright
servers.description: Microsoft Playwright MCP (official) — drive a real browser: navigate, click, fill, screenshot (24 tools).
servers.notes: Needs browser binaries on the host; wakes with an honest error where none exist (JEXI's native browser covers that). Needs a browser with system deps on the host. Connect+list verified here; full navigation needs the host browser. JEXI native browser control covers browsing where this cannot run.

servers.name: chrome-devtools
servers.description: Chrome DevTools MCP — inspect, debug and profile pages via the DevTools protocol (29 tools).
servers.notes: Needs Chrome on the host; honest error where absent. Needs Chrome at the host default path. Connect+list verified here; page tools need Chrome on the host.

servers.name: duckduckgo
servers.description: DuckDuckGo web search MCP — keyless search, fetch page content, expand links.
servers.notes: No key, no signup (MIT, nickclyde/duckduckgo-mcp-server). Ships the curl-cffi browser-fingerprint backend (small lib, NOT a browser). VERIFIED LIVE: works from normal IPs; hard-blocked from datacenter IPs like the brain's Render host even with the backend (auto mode returns empty, forced mode times out — tested Sept 2026). On the brain, live web search rides free-search (Wikipedia/StackExchange engines, proven) + wikipedia/arxiv/rss/hackernews instead.

servers.notes: No key for the default engines (MIT). API-key engines exist but stay unused.
